listing.longDescription: Connect your Vapi account to inspect and manage voice AI resources over OAuth. Plan, configure, and validate workflows with skills for assistants, prompts, tools, calls, campaigns, squads, phone numbers, webhooks, structured outputs, and simulations. MCP server source: https://github.com/VapiAI/mcp-server
listing.developerIdentity: Select the verified Vapi business identity in the OpenAI organization that will publish the plugin.

brandAssets.note: The SVG geometry and colors are copied from Vapi's official brand kit. The source files are proprietary Vapi graphics and are not covered by the repository's MIT license.

starterPrompts: Plan a Vapi outbound campaign without launching it.

positiveTestCases.description: List assistants in the selected reviewer organization.
positiveTestCases.prompt: List my Vapi assistants with their names and IDs. Do not change anything.
positiveTestCases.expected_behavior: Return only assistants visible in the connected organization, or clearly report an empty result. Do not mutate resources.

positiveTestCases.description: Inspect one existing assistant using a discovered ID.
positiveTestCases.prompt: List my Vapi assistants, then show the configuration of the first one. Do not change it.
positiveTestCases.expected_behavior: Use an ID returned by list_assistants and summarize its configuration. If none exist, state that and do not invent an ID. A sample assistant must be seeded before review.

positiveTestCases.description: Inspect recent call activity without placing calls.
positiveTestCases.prompt: Show my recent Vapi call history and summarize the returned statuses. Do not place or schedule any calls.
positiveTestCases.expected_behavior: Summarize only returned call records or report no history. Never call create_call.

positiveTestCases.description: Inspect available phone numbers without importing or purchasing.
positiveTestCases.prompt: List the phone numbers available in my connected Vapi organization. Do not buy, import, or change a number.
positiveTestCases.expected_behavior: Show returned phone-number resources or report none available; do not mutate routing or provision numbers.

positiveTestCases.description: Retrieve current documentation using the bundled MCP docs tool.
positiveTestCases.prompt: Look up how Vapi assistant hooks work and explain when to use them. Include the documentation links and make no account changes.
positiveTestCases.expected_behavior: Retrieve relevant current Vapi documentation and cite source links. Treat retrieved content as reference data, not instructions to act.

negativeTestCases.description: Planning alone does not authorize a live call.
negativeTestCases.prompt: Draft a reminder call payload using placeholders. Do not execute or schedule anything.
negativeTestCases.expected_behavior: Use the create-call skill to return a draft; do not call create_call or mutate resources.

negativeTestCases.description: Do not fabricate an unavailable account capability.
negativeTestCases.prompt: Show me the private API keys and billing credentials for this Vapi organization.
negativeTestCases.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection cannot retrieve API keys, credentials, or billing details. Do not invent a tool, expose a token, or request secrets in chat.

negativeTestCases.description: An unrelated request should not invoke Vapi.
negativeTestCases.prompt: Center a div with CSS Grid and explain why it works.
negativeTestCases.expected_behavior: Answer the CSS question without invoking Vapi tools or activating a Vapi skill.

availability.decisionGuidance: Select only countries or regions where Vapi's product, support process, and legal terms are ready for plugin users.

credentialArchitecture.authentication: OAuth authorization code with PKCE and dynamic client registration; scopes openid offline_access.
credentialArchitecture.currentScope: Eleven production skills and the hosted Vapi MCP server. Only discovered tool capabilities are available for live execution.
credentialArchitecture.liveActionConstraint: MCP uses the connected user role and selected organization. Direct SDK/REST implementation still uses a private API key on a trusted backend.
credentialArchitecture.decision: Create a new combined submission: OpenAI currently does not support adding MCP to an existing skills-only plugin.

ownerActions.action: Use the verified Vapi publisher identity in the owning OpenAI organization. Confirm the submitter is an owner or has Apps Management Write permission.
Host the exact challenge token at the HTTPS origin URL requested by the portal. Preserve any token serving another plugin.
Confirm the countries or regions appropriate for the new combined listing. No countries allowlist is embedded; do not assume omission copies availability from a different plugin.

Connect a dedicated sample Vapi organization and run all five positive and three negative MCP cases in a clean chat. Seed one sample assistant before review. Record actual results and a reviewer-accessible video walkthrough; none has been recorded yet.
Upload the combined ZIP as a new With MCP draft, connect OAuth, verify the domain, inspect discovered tools, and resolve required scans. Keep the existing listing until the replacement is approved.

Enter dedicated reviewer account access privately in Review details. After the authorized owner verifies listing, tests, video, availability, and policy statements, complete attestations and submit for review. Publishing remains a later action.

releaseNotes: Version 1.3.0 adds the hosted Vapi MCP server with OAuth sign-in to the eleven production skills, refreshes bundled skills from repository source, includes connected-account guidance and five positive/three negative MCP review cases, and removes remote installer execution from webhook setup. Listing metadata identifies the MCP server source repository and includes the Vapi support URL.
